metaDescription: Order custom 10 oz hot cold packs for promotions or safety kits. Branded reusable gel packs at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 10 oz hot cold packs offer a versatile size for treating minor injuries or keeping lunches cool. The 10-ounce capacity is large enough to provide sustained therapy on shoulders or knees yet compact enough to toss into a first aid kit or gym bag. Choose screen printing or a custom label to add your logo, making these gel packs a practical giveaway for safety events, corporate wellness programs, or outdoor promotions.
heroAltText: Custom 10 oz hot cold pack with reusable gel and company logo, ideal for first aid and promotional use.
